obvious_hallucination.content: 13. 29% of Llama's errors on convolution are arithmetic/reasoning errors rather than convention errors
obvious_hallucination.reason: The repository computes error rates over all 100 convolution items, not shares of the error subset. In error_breakdown.json Llama convolution has 66 correct, 29 arithmetic errors, and 5 convention errors; with 34 total errors, arithmetic errors are 29% of items but about 85% of errors. The paper wording therefore misreports the quantity.

The repository stores parsing failures for Llama completeness as a rate over all 100 items, not over the 18 error cases. error_breakdown.json shows 82 correct, 18 parsing failures, and 0 convention errors, so parsing failures are 18% of items but 100% of errors. The paper wording conflicts with the saved analysis.
